answer: In an agent economy resisting Sybil attacks, each verified identity must bond a substantial economic stake that scales with its voting or transaction power. Attackers seeking many fakes incur repeated capital lockup costs that compound quickly, while legitimate agents can reallocate stakes across sessions. A velvet oversight layer analyzes whisper-protocol gossip of peer attestations to detect umber low-bond clusters, triggering progressive slashing or isolation. This mechanism forces Sybil operators to forfeit real value far exceeding short-term rewards.
